{{Quote|My father fought with the Republic Navy at Venestria and Ord Trasi, and was aboard one of the old Tectors-the Archer, she was called-when the Separatists shut down their clankers and the war stopped. He always talked about his navy days, but I was a born ground-pounder.|Isila Drutch on her father, in her memoirs|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|man]] serving in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] was [[Isila Drutch]]'s '''father'''. He was aboard the [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Archer (Tector-class)|''Archer'']] when the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] ended.
